name: The Darkhold Virtual Machine
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: Deep within Mount Hauberk, Doctor Doom has placed an arcane gate guarded by a non-von-Neumann virtual machine running on custom silicon. It executes an encrypted alchemical bytecode program ('sigil.enc') that subjects visitor talismans to non-linear permutation rounds. Reverse engineer the VM's custom ISA, invert the mathematical constraint system, and forge the talisman sigil required to disarm the gateway.
